title: Hearty Crunchy Peruvian Ladyfingers Skillet
description: A rich and crunchy Peruvian dish featuring ladyfingers, chocolate, and beef, all in one keto-friendly skillet.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Add the paprika, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the dried ladyfingers to the skillet and stir to combine with the beef and vegetable mixture.
Pour the melted chocolate over the ladyfingers and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
